programs.title: Pretty Baby: Brooke Shields
programs.desc: From sexualized young girl to Princeton graduate, Brooke navigates her extraordinary childhood and complex relationship with mother/manager Teri. Brooke’s early career, defined by a sexuality she could neither claim nor comprehend, catapults her to global superstardom, and forces her to navigate a toxic culture that wants to sell her to mass audiences. Brooke defies all stereotypes by going to college. This program contains mature themes, viewer discretion is advised.
